rules.rationale: This is the nonpositive base equation defining oddDigitsProduct as the empty product.
This is the guarded odd-positive recurrence defining oddDigitsProduct by multiplying the last decimal digit and recursing on the remaining prefix.
This is the guarded even-positive recurrence defining oddDigitsProduct by discarding the even last digit and recursing on the remaining prefix.
This is the nonpositive base equation defining oddDigitSeen to be zero before any positive decimal digit is examined.
This is the guarded odd-positive defining equation for oddDigitSeen, returning one when the current decimal digit is odd.
This is the guarded even-positive recurrence defining oddDigitSeen by continuing with the remaining decimal prefix.
This simplification rule adds the integer left-multiplicative-identity fact; Stage 1 compiles it before kprove and contains no earlier rule-free proof of its exact statement.
This simplification rule adds the integer right-multiplicative-identity fact; Stage 1 compiles it before kprove and contains no earlier rule-free proof of its exact statement.
This simplification rule adds an integer cancellation identity used to normalize the presence bit; Stage 1 supplies no separate prior proof of the exact rule.
This simplification rule adds integer multiplication associativity in a chosen normalization direction; Stage 1 supplies no separate prior proof of the exact rule.
